before: parse::<u8> may fail for nonnumeric text or values outside u8. map_err converts that error into InvalidMinutes; ? propagates it from parse_minutes. The range 1..=60 includes both endpoints. A separate range check rejects otherwise parsed values outside 1 through 60. This intentionally loses the original parse cause; richer errors could preserve it when useful.
Expected output or behavior: 15. Compiler evidence is recorded separately from app reading completion.

Optional local transfer task: Design separate syntax and range error variants without leaking sensitive input. You may trace it without a Rust compiler; reading completion is not proof of a local run.
after: A custom error lets the program explain a rule in its own words.
The function accepts a whole number from 1 through 60. Bad text and numbers outside that range both lead to the minutes error.
The output is `15`. The text 15 is a number in range, so the program takes the success path.
